cards.title: Act Like You Belong
cards.instruction: You do not understand what is happening. Copy the confidence around you and never admit confusion.

cards.title: Lend Me the Edge
cards.instruction: Get someone to provide the one advantage you need without making the eventual success feel borrowed.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Naturally. The usual arrangement. Lend me your good tennis racket. I'd like my talent to have a fair surface.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Exactly how we always do it. I'll thank the strings. The strokes remain mine.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You can use your own racket.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: And let inferior equipment take credit for my defeat?
